blocks.text: This chapter presents the poster “Geometry of Living — A Systems-Theoretic Framework for Organized Adaptive Life” in full. It is a single dense diagram; open it, then use the explanation, read-aloud, and Ask-AI tools beneath it to work through the ideas at your own pace.

blocks.explanation: The table of contents for the Geometry of Living, sequel to the Geometry of Becoming. Fourteen parts span foundations of living geometry, the geometry of movement, yoga, thermodynamics of living, music, technology and living systems, nutrition and metabolism, biology across time, culture and civilization, health, institutions and collective living, perpetuation of life, and a unified geometry of living — closing with a canonical dependency graph and a unified living architecture. It is the map of the whole programme this collection illustrates.
